text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: What in the world... was that?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...I don't know. I don't understand it, 
but... this power overflowing from my 
body...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
With who I am right now... I feel like I 
can show them a "miracle"!
